In my situation, if I were willing to do tidaiyi (alternative service,) do I get Taiwanese citizenship instantly?
My parents are Taiwanese, have a house in Hsinchu, and I have a Taiwanese passport. I was born in the US and so I'm apparently a half-citizen, a national or something. I'm 34.

If I wanted full Taiwanese citizenship, though, and am **willing** to do alternative service (tidaiyi) or even military conscription to do so, how do I get it? Do I just walk into the government office and say "Yup I want it, sign me up for the tidaiyi" and I get the citizenship status within days?
